principle: Deploy a useful configuration, not a different operating system.

experience_depth.rule: Depth changes presentation and discoverability, never deletes data or silently changes configured services.

areas.rule: Areas are composable configuration profiles, not separate edenOS editions.

roaming.rule: Logical workspace roams; physical presentation is regenerated locally.

policy_rule: Explicit managed policy is distinct from user preference.
upgrade_rule: Base OS, providers, profiles and user overrides upgrade independently; preserve provenance and user customization.
